bbox_convention: [x0, y0, x1, y1), x1/y1 exclusive; union of every changed pixel in mask, depth, shaded and id
notes: mask and depth change only where the rim moved (and the faces beneath it); shaded/id also change where the top zones were re-zoned (verge band within 1.6 m of the new rim)

the shaded canvas also carries 1-2 LSB changes along the interior edges of the 53 re-triangulated top triangles (MSAA centroid sampling across zone-colour edges); they lie inside bbox_px and are counted in changed_px_shaded
v4.1 triangles that avoid the patched rim are pinned (cliffside_v4_2_tris.py), so nothing outside bbox_px moves
